system.title: System Settings
system.description: Manage global application configuration and integrations

global.title: Global Settings
global.description: These settings apply to the whole application. Future global options should be managed here as well.

baseUrl.title: BASE URL
baseUrl.label: Public app URL
baseUrl.description: Used for reverse proxy deployments, OIDC callbacks, and post-login redirects. Include the full subpath if the app is hosted under one.

timezone.title: Global timezone
timezone.label: System timezone
timezone.description: Executor maintenance windows and statistics charts use this IANA timezone, for example Asia/Shanghai.

logLevel.title: Log level
logLevel.label: Backend log level
logLevel.description: Controls backend application logging after startup.

releaseHistoryCount.title: Release history count
releaseHistoryCount.label: Versions per release channel
releaseHistoryCount.description: Keep the latest N versions for each release channel. Cleanup runs after executor maintenance windows finish, or daily at 02:00 when no maintenance windows exist.
releaseHistoryCount.cleanupSuccess: Release history cleanup completed. Deleted {{count}} records.

snapshotHistoryCount.title: Snapshot history count
snapshotHistoryCount.label: Snapshots per executor
snapshotHistoryCount.description: Keep the latest N snapshots for each executor. Older snapshots are pruned after new snapshots are saved.
snapshotHistoryCount.cleanupSuccess: Snapshot history cleanup completed. Deleted {{count}} snapshots.

ociRegistryRedirects.title: OCI registry redirects
ociRegistryRedirects.label: Enable registry redirect compatibility
ociRegistryRedirects.description: Keep this disabled unless your registry requires redirects for tag, manifest, token, or blob access.
ociRegistryRedirects.enabledHint: Redirect compatibility is enabled for newly started container source checks.
ociRegistryRedirects.disabledHint: Redirect support is disabled. Registry redirects will be rejected before following them.

basic.title: Basic Environment
basic.description: Configure public application address, system timezone, and logging verbosity.

fetchAndReadiness.title: Fetch & Readiness Strategy
fetchAndReadiness.description: Manage image registry behavior, fetch retries, and default observer timing for executor rollouts.

storageAndRetention.title: Storage & Retention
storageAndRetention.description: Manage retention thresholds for releases and snapshots, and trigger manual cleanup.

general.title: General Settings
general.description: Manage version sorting and data fetching preferences
general.versionSortModeDesc: Choose how the system picks the latest version from tracking records
general.fetchLimitDesc: The maximum number of records to fetch per check. Higher limits are useful for projects that release frequently.

oidc.title: OIDC Login Providers
oidc.dialogDesc: Configure an OpenID Connect provider for user login
oidc.requiredFields: Please fill in all required fields
oidc.secretRequired: Client secret is required when creating a provider
oidc.deleteDesc: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? Existing users will no longer be able to log in with this provider.
oidc.bindingDescription: Only the explicitly bound OIDC identity can sign in as the administrator.
oidc.bindingPasswordDescription: Re-enter the local administrator password before changing the OIDC binding.
